description: This file contains a PHP class implementing the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing functionality for URI parsing, assembly, manipulation, and validation within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: A PSR-7 URI implementation that provides methods for URI parsing, building, and validation in compliance with RFC 3986 and PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: composeComponents
methods.description: Constructs a full URI string from individual components such as scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Checks if the port of a given URI is the default for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if a URI is absolute, i.e., has a scheme.

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference.

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative-path reference.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if a URI is a same-document reference relative to a base URI.

methods.name: withoutQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI instance with a specified query parameter removed.

methods.name: withQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specified query parameter set or replaced.

methods.name: withQueryValues
methods.description: Creates a new URI with multiple query parameters from an associative array.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Constructs a URI instance from an array of parse_url components.
